stem: Omar adds the scores $5$, $6$, $9$, $2$, and $1$ from five short games. He wants the even-or-odd nature of the total from the number of odd addends.

statements.text: The odd addends are $5$, $9$, and $1$, so there are three odd addends.
Three odd addends make the total odd.
The total is even because three of the five scores are odd.

teacher.key_rationale: Odd addends are 5, 9, and 1 (three of them). An odd count of odd addends makes an odd total. Statement 3 wrongly calls that total even.
